# umami_pixel (Resource)

A tracking pixel: a 1×1 image at `<umami url>/p/<slug>` that records a view each time it is loaded, for emails and pages where the tracking script cannot run. Deleting a team deletes its pixels. See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/pixels) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_config" "server" {}

resource "umami_pixel" "newsletter" {
  name = "Newsletter opens"
  slug = "newsletter-opens"
}

output "pixel_tag" {
  value = "<img src=\"${coalesce(data.umami_config.server.pixels_url, "https://analytics.example.com/p")}/${umami_pixel.newsletter.slug}\" width=\"1\" height=\"1\" alt=\"\">"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name of the pixel.
- `slug` (String) Path segment of the pixel URL, `<umami url>/p/<slug>` (or under `links_url`/`pixels_url` of `umami_config` when set). 8 to 100 letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, unique among the pixels of the Umami instance.

### Optional

- `team_id` (String) ID of the team that owns the pixel. Owned by the authenticated user when omitted. Umami cannot move a pixel to another owner, so changing this replaces it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the pixel.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user that owns the pixel, when it is not owned by a team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the pixel ID.
terraform import umami_pixel.example 35c22b8a-14c0-4cf8-ac51-992a875d9918
```
